theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_pc_measurable_inverse
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (H : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)), ContinuousOn H B → MeasurableSet B → InjOn H B → MeasurableSet (H '' B) ∧ ∃ h : Euclid P → Euclid n, Measurable h ∧ ∀ u ∈ B, h (H u) = u
